description: Sends one draft later, from Pidgeon’s side, with no further call: it goes even if you and the person are offline. Pass the time as `send_at`, ISO 8601 with an offset, a minute to 90 days ahead. Prefer this over scheduling a task of your own. If the address asks a person first, it waits for their approval and goes at `send_at` once they give it. Each scheduled message goes on its own; one refused never stops another. `unschedule_draft` takes it back.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: schedule_draft
title: Send a draft later
